lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nb10Te8 (reduced formula Nb5Te4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Nb centers with 8-fold (4 Nb, 4 Te) and 9-fold (2 Nb, 7 Te) environments, while Te centers adopt 9-fold and 10-fold Nb/Tc environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and face-sharing between Nb 8-vertex and 9-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Nb 8-vertex and Te 9-vertex polyhedra.
